test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per a news report in February 2022, which city will be home to the country's first e-waste eco-park, which will take care of rising e-waste?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Delhi Cabinet** has approved setting up **India’s first-of-its-kind electronic-waste eco-park**.
 
• The electronic waste eco-friendly park is to be built on **20 acres of land in Delhi.**
 
• This eco-park will act as an** Integrated Facility, by engaging in dismantling, segregating, refurbishing, material-wise storage, testing and plastic recycling.**
 
• It will also have precious metal extraction facilities, especially from Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs) through high-end technologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
